confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Marseille tourist pricing in peak summer, not checked against live menus, bar prices or booking pages. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation anchors are least certain because July rates vary widely by season and location. Beer, wine and cocktail anchors use the usual French bar-price relationship where direct knowledge is weak. The FX observation comes from RBA table data surfaced by search and was not verified on the live table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other large French Mediterranean cities with similar summer tourist demand, such as Nice and Montpellier, with Marseille's Vieux-Port and bistro pricing and generally somewhat lower peak-season hotel rates than Nice. Prices reflect the July 2026 reference month, which is peak season.
